headline: Vercel 实验室放出给智能体用的界面 SDK，交互行为可接到主流前端框架；同期编程代理的技能包与桌面管理器也在涨星。
headlineEn: Vercel Labs released a UI SDK for agents, with interaction behaviors that plug into major frontend stacks, while coding-agent skills and desktop managers also rose.

lead.name: vercel-labs/ui
lead.zh: 给智能体用的界面行为库，核心覆盖键盘、焦点、选择与拖放，并提供多框架适配。
lead.en: A behavior library so agents can assemble interfaces, with core primitives and adapters for several UI frameworks.
lead.why: 读者里很多人每天都在让编程代理改界面。这个库把导航、焦点和弹出层等行为收进 SDK，也可作为技能交给代理去用。
lead.whyEn: Many of you already let coding agents touch the UI. This SDK packages navigation, focus, and overlay behaviors, and can be handed to an agent as a skill.

sections.title: 编程代理的技能、口令与方法
sections.titleEn: Skills, design cues, and methods for coding agents

items.name: affaan-m/ECC
items.zh: 面向 Claude Code、Codex 与 Cursor 的代理运行时，覆盖技能、记忆、安全，并警告只从官方渠道安装。
items.en: A harness for several coding agents that bundles skills, memory, and security, with a hard warning to install only from official channels.

items.name: pbakaus/impeccable
items.zh: 给编程代理一套设计用语，用 polish、critique 等指令约束界面品味，并在发版前检查敷衍输出。
items.en: A shared design vocabulary so coding agents can be steered, reviewed, and checked for sloppy UI before you ship.

items.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.zh: 作者称在 Claude Code 对照实验中代码约少百分之五十三，风险逻辑带测试的比例更高。
items.en: The author reports that the same agent wrote far less code in a Claude Code benchmark, while more of the risky logic shipped with tests.

items.name: obra/superpowers
items.zh: 一套可组合的技能，加上要求代理真正去用它们的初始指令，形成完整开发方法。
items.en: A methodology made of composable skills plus bootstrap instructions that push the agent to actually use them.

sections.title: 配置切换、代码地图与代理护栏
sections.titleEn: Provider switching, codebase maps, and agent guardrails

items.name: farion1231/cc-switch
items.zh: 桌面里切换 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等的接口供应商，并集中改 MCP、技能和提示。
items.en: A desktop app to switch API providers for several coding CLIs and to edit MCP, skills, and prompts without hand-editing config files.

items.name: FreeFlow Dictation
items.zh: 苹果电脑上的设备端听写，并带有接到 Claude Code 的语音挂钩。
items.en: Dictation that runs on a Mac, plus a voice hook aimed at Claude Code.

items.name: haydenschmitty/floorplan
items.zh: 由 Claude 或 Codex 阅读仓库，生成带白话名称和连线的交互式代码结构图。
items.en: Claude or Codex reads your repo and draws an interactive map of parts, files, and requests in plain language.

items.name: Antelog
items.zh: 用来拦住编程代理把数据外泄或毁掉。
items.en: A guard that keeps coding agents from leaking or wiping your data.

sections.title: 会议纪要留在本机
sections.titleEn: Meeting notes that stay on the machine

items.name: FrigadeHQ/yogurt
items.zh: 会议录音与摘要留在本机处理，开源替代方案，且不往会议里加机器人。
items.en: Call notes transcribed and summarized on your own machine, without dropping a bot into the meeting.

items.name: Tacie
items.zh: 通话里不出现机器人，只在 Mac 上留下会议笔记。
items.en: Mac meeting notes that never put a bot in the room.
